sources.snippet: The base model's tokenizer was pre-extended with ~300 SPE (SMILES Pair Encoding) chemistry tokens plus <|start_of_smiles|> / <|end_of_smiles|> special tokens. The embed_tokens and lm_head layers are saved as full (non-LoRA) trainable copies via modules_to_save because they were resized during tokenizer extension.
